definition.proposition: In the assembled model (A2s: GDN hybrid, shared core 6x2, ternary core, contractive injection), replacing the core's dense FFN with a FLOP-matched ternary MoE FFN (4 experts x 512, top-2) improves clean80 bpc by about 3.3% at 200M tokens of code-py-v2.

scope.precision: ternary BitNet b1.58 via STE + int8 activations in the core

definition.refutation_criteria: REFUTED if a fresh-seed replication's paired 95% CI includes 0

qual: 3 fresh seeds, registered, Holm family of 4
reason: A3m - A2s = -3.29%, paired 95% CI [-4.24, -2.33], df 2, per seed -3.67 / -3.27 / -2.91 (seeds 5-7); Holm step 4 (alpha 0.05) rejects; prediction -3% (-6% to -1%): in range.

verified_at.basis: HEAD of the checkout when the event was recorded

limitations.text: Costs 47% more total non-embedding params (22.2M vs 15.1M; weight memory 36.6 vs 35.1 MB at 1.58-bit ternary) and 17% lower training throughput (285k vs 343k tok/s, RTX 5090).
One horizon (200M tokens); the MoE's benefit at longer horizons (SQ380) and per-pass routing behaviour (SQ382) are untested.

qual: registered rule met, Holm CI excludes 0; LR robustness not shown
reason: Claim audit 2026-11-23-1404 (confirmed): statistics policy 2.3 requires both arms tuned or LR-robust. A2s and the A3 arm both ran at 6e-3, inherited from E27's bracket and never bracketed themselves. Restored to VERIFIED only if A3 amendment 1 (A2s and A3mx at 3e-3 / 1.2e-2, seed 5) shows 6e-3 within 1% of the best.

reason: confirmed; PARTIAL pending LR bracket (A3 amendment 1)

qual: 3 fresh seeds, registered, Holm; LR-robust (A3 amendment 1)
reason: A3 amendment 1 (registered v0.5.18) passed: seed-5 clean80 at {3e-3, 6e-3, 1.2e-2}: A2s 0.27291 / 0.27449 / 0.28367 (best 3e-3; 6e-3 is +0.58%, within 1%), A3mx 0.25333 / 0.25176 / 0.25793 (best 6e-3). Both arms are LR-robust at 6e-3 by the registered rule, so policy 2.3 is met and the registered results stand.

verified_at.basis: HEAD of the checkout when the event was recorded

limitations.text: A2s's best bracketed LR is 3e-3 (0.58% better than 6e-3 at seed 5), so effects measured against A2s at 6e-3 may be overstated by up to about 0.6 points; no registered decision changes (every fix stays beyond -1%).

reason: B1 SQ401 (registered, exploratory 20M screen, seeds 0-2): A3m vs A2s = -1.01% [-1.83, -0.18] (same direction as C206's -3.3% at 200M). Capacity control G1: a dense core SwiGLU of hidden 2048 (the MoE bank's total width) vs A3m = +0.15% [-0.88, +1.20], a tie, while the dense arm uses 45% more training FLOPs (5.49e15 vs 3.79e15). So at 20M the ternary MoE core matches a dense FFN of the same total width at the dense-1024 compute: routing buys that capacity per FLOP. Not Holm-significant (G1 p 0.59), as expected for a tie.
